scope: QA independent review of the render perf slice and the S8 non-blocking fixes: independent recomputation of every statistic in official_summary from the 2x30 raw series (nearest-rank with Rust round semantics), consistency of summary/ratios/windows/warmup/iterations, independent perf measurement with a QA-owned harness (same protocol, 3 separate processes), independent memory working-set measurement over two full cycles, QA-owned nvidia-smi/compute-apps sampling of the measurement window, relative-only scope check, unmet-item coverage, evidence integrity and diff scope, and verification of the three 18ae715 S8 fixes plus S8 number non-regression. No product source changes in the reviewed commits; no full G01.

method.harness: target/qa-perf-harness (QA crate, product path dependency + cuda-probe, debug build = same profile as the delivered test; QA driver for camlight poses/context/rays)
method.protocol: warmup=5, iterations=30, frame_ms = render call + RGB read-back sync, nearest-rank min/median/p95 with Rust f64::round, per-120k-ray normalisation

official_summary_derivation.raw_series: measurement_a / measurement_b, each 2 modes x 30 frame_ms + 30 launch_ms (warmup=5 not in series)

qa_independent_measurements.conclusion: same order of magnitude and the same relative relationship; differences are window-to-window desktop-load variation, and the delivered evidence only claims a relative baseline

memory.judgment: the '52 MiB one-time driver code-cache/pool retention, not a leak' explanation is structurally supported: a one-time drop that does not grow per cycle, per-frame free is constant and only the 2 MiB context returns on destroy; the absolute magnitude differs by process state/first-frame loading timing and does not change the non-leak conclusion

exclusivity.evidence_strength_note: on Windows the compute-apps list keeps desktop graphics entries and shows N/A memory, so 'no other CUDA compute process' is evidenced by the process list plus the memory curve returning to the desktop baseline plus the peak band matching this task; sub-100 ms peaks may be missed (declared in the unmet items)

s8_fix_18ae715.s8_readme_upstream_equivalence_context: only inside a negated sentence ('上游完全等价未声明…')

diff_18ae715.note: tests/render_e2e.rs + fixture + authoring script + S8 evidence + .normify only

性能数字只对本窗口/本机有效，不可作固定指标或跨硬件依据。
